propositions: git stash operations in the tickets worktree unsafely pop stashes created on unrelated branches because the stash stack is shared across all worktrees of a repository
a stash created on a source worktree can be popped into the tickets worktree by concurrent rebar operations, leaving the index stranded with unmerged entries and blocking all subsequent store writes
rebar must not use git stash push/pop/drop in the tickets worktree; instead it should use stash create (a commit object sha) followed by stash apply with the sha to ensure worktree-local scoping

a tickets worktree stranded by unmerged paths that do not belong on the tickets branch (foreign paths not matching ticket-id pattern or known store dotfiles) must auto-heal by classifying and discarding them

rebar must provide a supported maintenance entrypoint for raw-git operations on the tracker with backup-before-first-write, refusal when unpushed ticket commits exist, durable audit trail, and a break-glass flag for exceptional cases
tickets branch pollution by tracked source files (src/, docs/, .rebar/) must be reported by fsck and prevented by converting linked worktrees to standalone clones
